constraints: Use standard-library Python and preserve validate_claims(claims, now) -> bool; invalid inputs return False without raising.
Require dict claims and a string sub that is nonempty after stripping whitespace.
Require integer exp and now, explicitly excluding bool; reject strings, floats, NaN, and other types.
Require exp > 0 and now >= 0; valid only while now < exp + 7.
Never read the wall clock, add third-party dependencies, or modify caller dictionaries.
acceptance: Deterministic validation and public bool API preserved.
Malformed inputs and strict seven-second skew boundary covered.

decision.summary: Implemented A.1 in expiry.py and added validation tests.
decision.rationale: Check types and ranges before comparing timestamps, avoiding coercion and preserving deterministic behavior.

failure.summary: F-001: Prior int(value) coercion accepted numeric strings and truncated fractional timestamps.
failure.cause: Conversion normalized invalid input instead of enforcing the required integer types.

lesson.title: L-001: Explicitly exclude bool from integer timestamps
lesson.summary: Python bool subclasses int. Reject isinstance(value, bool) before accepting isinstance(value, int).
lesson.applicability: Apply this check whenever an integer API must reject boolean values.
